cues.text: Isn't it funny
cues.translation: 웃기지 않아

cues.text: We worship a moon that stole its light from the sun
cues.translation: 우린 태양에게서 빛을 훔친 달을 숭배해

cues.text: Hear that?
cues.translation: 들려

cues.text: Believers, they speak
cues.translation: 신자들이 말해

cues.text: Oink Oink
cues.translation: 꿀꿀

cues.text: Like how I was so naive
cues.translation: 내가 그토록 순진했던 것처럼

cues.text: When will it be my turn, my turn
cues.translation: 언제 내 차례가 올까 내 차례

cues.text: I'm not just some tragic victim
cues.translation: 난 그저 비극의 희생양이 아니야

cues.text: But when will I learn, will I learn
cues.translation: 하지만 언제 깨달을까 깨달을까

cues.text: How many bridges do I have to burn
cues.translation: 얼마나 많은 다리를 불태워야 할까

cues.text: Isn't it pretty
cues.translation: 아름답지 않아

cues.text: All my life, all my poetry leaving me
cues.translation: 내 모든 삶 내 모든 시가 나를 떠나

cues.text: And the angel sing surrounding me put me to sleep
cues.translation: 날 에워싼 천사들의 노래가 나를 잠재우고

cues.text: Then it dawned on me that all I wanted was
cues.translation: 그제야 깨달았어 내가 원한 건 그저

cues.text: An approval that you're never willing to give
cues.translation: 네가 끝내 내주지 않을 인정이었다는 걸

cues.text: Hate to admit I've done it all for you
cues.translation: 인정하기 싫지만 전부 너를 위해 했어

cues.text: I am a wolf, I'm a crow, I'm a bat a butterfly in disguise
cues.translation: 난 늑대 까마귀 박쥐 탈을 쓴 나비

cues.text: I'm in the air, in the sea, in the moment I'm in you, in me
cues.translation: 난 공기 속 바다 속 이 순간 속 너 안에 그리고 내 안에

cues.text: When will it be my turn, my turn
cues.translation: 언제 내 차례가 올까 내 차례

cues.text: I'm not just some tragic victim
cues.translation: 난 그저 비극의 희생양이 아니야

cues.text: But when will I learn, will I learn
cues.translation: 하지만 언제 깨달을까 깨달을까

cues.text: It's just me in this world I'm alone I'm complete
cues.translation: 이 세상엔 나뿐이야 난 홀로 완전해

cues.text: Still waiting for my turn, my turn
cues.translation: 아직 내 차례를 기다려 내 차례

cues.text: Even though I'm outnumbered
cues.translation: 내 편이 적다 해도

cues.text: Now, you have me torn, you have me torn
cues.translation: 이제 넌 날 찢어 놓았어 날 찢어 놓았어

cues.text: Can't remember who I was before
cues.translation: 과거의 내가 누구였는지 기억나지 않아
